alignments.note: Nominal predicate with the construction-supplied copula under rule 20 and a supplied *the* on the construct noun under rule 29.

Preposition on a construct noun rendered by the single word *before*; fused under rule 30 and headed on the construct noun. The phrase is the predicate of the verbless clause, so the linking verb the ASV writes where a copula would stand joins the unit under rules 20 and 49, the unit discontinuous under rule 25 and still headed on the relational word. The competing reading marks *goeth* `added` as a supplied lexical verb; its italic corroborates neither side, by rule 7.
Nomen rectum of the fused compound preposition.
Subject noun of the verbless clause.

review_notes: The one contested unit is the supplied *goeth*, taken as the copula of the prepositional predicate under rule 49 rather than as an `added` lexical verb.
